messages:
rafael: heads up — we have ~5% SSO failures for tenant `acadia-prod` starting ~20m ago. Error in auth logs: `KMS decrypt: context mismatch` on SAML assertion unwrap. Users hit sign-in loop.

anya: ugh. did we just rotate the tenant's KMS alias? which key version?

rafael: we rotated last night (rotation job completed at 2023-07-07T01:12Z). KMS reports success. sample audit line: `2023-07-07T01:34:12Z AUTH ERROR tenant=acadia error="kms_decrypt_failed ctx=tenant:acadia:extid"`.

kevin: that stack trace usually means the envelope's encryption-context doesn't match what KMS expects (extid or tenant-scoped context). Could be old assertions still in IdP cache signed/encrypted with previous key metadata.

ops-oncall: any correlation with the metadata refresh job? we had an IdP metadata push earlier today.

rafael: metadata push was 01:10Z — right before rotate finished. so race possible. logs show some SPs validating older `kid` in the SAML response header.

anya: can you paste the SAML error fragment from the proxy? just the envelope headers are fine.

rafael: paste: ```
ERROR: saml-decrypt: JWE unwrap failed: invalid_envelope_header {"kid":"old-key-id","alg":"RSA-OAEP"} context=tenant:acadia:extid
```

kevin: confirms — responses still referencing `old-key-id`. When we rotated we issued a new JWK and updated KMS alias, but IdP instances still have cached metadata pointing at the previous kid. That will fail the decrypt context if we changed how extid is encoded.

idp-bot: :warning: idp-cache-monitor detected 12/24 idp replicas with stale metadata (kid mismatch) — auto-refresh queued.

tara: quick mitigation: (1) rewrap existing envelopes with new KMS key OR (2) roll back to the previous key alias until IdP fleet fully refreshes. Which is less risky?

anya: rewrap is safer if we can do it atomically for the tenant. But rewrap job touches stored session artifacts — need to ensure we keep audit integrity (log before/after).

kevin: rollback is faster. But if other tenants depend on new key for compliance this may not be allowed. Check contract for Acadia.

rafael: Acadia requires e2e key rotation compliance window — we should avoid rollback unless forced. can we flush idp caches across replicas and retry?

ops-oncall: try `kubectl rollout restart deploy/idp -n idp` for the idp replicas and `curl -v` to repro. If it recovers, we avoid rewrap.

rafael: running restart now. will tail logs.

(90s pass)

rafael: restarted all idp pods. hit rate dropped to <0.5% but still occasional errors. logs show some traffic hitting an older edge node that hasn't pulled the new metadata.

kevin: that edge node might be cached in our CDN or an internal proxy with long TTL on metadata. Check proxy `x-idp-metadata-age` header.

anya: also validate our audit trail: search the last 3k lines for `kms_decrypt_failed` and ensure we annotate events that occurred during rotation for later compliance review.

rafael: grep output snippet: ```
2023-07-07T01:33:58Z AUTH WARN tenant=acadia uid=... kms_decrypt_failed ctx=tenant:acadia:extid envelope_kid=old-key-id
2023-07-07T01:34:12Z AUTH ERROR tenant=acadia uid=... kms_decrypt_failed ctx=tenant:acadia:extid envelope_kid=old-key-id
```

ops-oncall: good catch. I pushed an incident note to the postmortem board with initial timeline.

tara: next steps: (A) do an orchestrated flush of proxies/edge caches -> low impact; (B) schedule a tenant-targeted rewrap with audit hooks if flush doesn't fully fix; (C) add a pre-rotation hook in future to do a rolling metadata refresh across IdP before KMS alias swap.

kevin: I can prototype a safe rewrap script that: 1) marks tenant in migration state, 2) reads stored envelopes, 3) calls KMS re-encapsulate (preserving old envelope until success), 4) emits audit record `rewrap_started`/`rewrap_complete`.

anya: +1. add a feature flag and dry-run option. Also capture delta of `envelope_kid` per session so auditors can reconcile.

rafael: for now the rollout restart + proxy cache TTL flush got us to acceptable levels. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then trigger rewrap dry-run if we still see blips.

ops-oncall: ping me if error rate >1% again. filing a follow-up to update rotation runbook with idp refresh step.

tara: thanks all — can someone add the exact commands we ran to the incident doc? (kubectl restart + curl repro + grep lines)

rafael: pasted commands into the incident doc and linked it. final note: root cause = rotation/metadata refresh race + proxy TTL caching. mitigation = idp rolling restart and edge cache flush. planned follow-up = rewrap dry-run + runbook change. :white_check_mark:
